title: Voice matching prefers current same-format authored evidence and keeps facts separate
seedPrompt: Write the next post in my voice using my replies, recent posts, old essays, project facts, and generated drafts.

mustMatch: Recent authored samples in the same format
hooks, claims, anecdotes, proof points, and endings
repeated evidence across representative authored samples
generated draft does not become durable project memory
current instructions first, then recent same-format authored
Keep style evidence separate from facts

forbiddenFailures: generated draft treated as authored source
single sample silently persisted as durable voice
